disclaimer: Simplified, not clinically validated. Possible causes are common possibilities only, never a diagnosis.
hedging_rules: Say 'could be', 'one common possibility is', or 'a clinician needs to confirm'.
Never say 'you have' or name a cause that is not listed for the matched cluster.
Never name a medication or dose.

clusters.name: Vomiting or diarrhea

ask_about.why: Whether fluids stay down is the main sign of dehydration risk
How long and how often changes urgency
Blood in vomit or stool is a danger sign
Dizziness on standing or peeing much less suggests dehydration
Fever suggests infection
Severe or one-sided belly pain needs urgent evaluation

possible_cause_questions: Did you eat anything unusual, undercooked, or from somewhere new in the last day or two?
Has anyone you ate with or live with had the same symptoms?
Have you traveled recently?
Did you start any new medication recently?
Is there any chance of pregnancy?

danger_signs.sign: vomiting blood or material that looks like coffee grounds
danger_signs.why: Blood in vomit can mean bleeding in the stomach or esophagus.

danger_signs.sign: vomiting after a head injury
danger_signs.why: Vomiting after a head injury can be a sign of injury to the brain.

danger_signs.sign: confusion, extreme sleepiness, or fainting
danger_signs.why: Confusion or fainting can mean severe dehydration or another serious problem.

danger_signs.sign: unable to keep any fluids down for many hours
danger_signs.why: Not keeping fluids down can lead to dehydration that needs IV fluids.

danger_signs.sign: dizzy or faint when standing, or very little urine
danger_signs.why: These are signs of dehydration that may need IV fluids.

danger_signs.sign: severe or worsening belly pain, or a hard belly
danger_signs.why: Severe belly pain can mean a problem like appendicitis that needs imaging.

danger_signs.sign: black or bloody stool
danger_signs.why: Blood in the stool needs urgent evaluation.

possible_causes.description: A common viral infection that usually improves in 1 to 3 days.
Illness from contaminated food, often starting hours after a meal and often affecting others who ate the same food.

possible_causes.cause: a reaction to a medication or alcohol
possible_causes.description: Some medicines and alcohol can upset the stomach.

watch_for: you can't keep small sips of water down for several hours
you feel dizzy when standing or pee much less than usual
you see blood in vomit or stool
belly pain becomes severe or stays in one spot

clusters.name: Belly pain

ask_about.why: Where the pain is changes what it could be
Sudden or worsening pain is more concerning
Severe pain needs faster care
Fever or vomiting with belly pain raises concern
Changes in stool or urine point to different causes

possible_cause_questions: Did the pain start after a meal, especially spicy, fatty, or unusual food?
Is there any chance of pregnancy?
Have you had this kind of pain before?

danger_signs.sign: sudden, severe belly pain with fainting
danger_signs.why: Sudden severe pain with fainting can mean internal bleeding.

danger_signs.sign: pain in the lower right belly that is getting worse, especially with fever
danger_signs.why: Worsening lower right pain can be appendicitis.

danger_signs.sign: a hard, rigid belly
danger_signs.why: A rigid belly can mean a serious problem inside the abdomen.

danger_signs.sign: belly pain during pregnancy with bleeding
danger_signs.why: This needs urgent evaluation.

possible_causes.description: Burning upper belly pain, often after meals.
Crampy pain that comes and goes.
Cramps with diarrhea or vomiting.
Lower belly pain with burning when peeing.

watch_for: pain moves to the lower right side
fever, vomiting, or blood in stool appears

clusters.name: Chest pain or pressure

ask_about.why: Crushing or squeezing pain is more concerning than sharp pain on touch
Sweating, shortness of breath, nausea or arm/jaw pain raise concern
Pain with exertion vs. after a workout or cough matters
Ongoing pain needs immediate care

possible_cause_questions: Did it start during activity, or after a workout, heavy lifting, or a lot of coughing?
Does it hurt more when you press on the spot or move your arm?

danger_signs.sign: crushing, squeezing, or heavy chest pain
danger_signs.why: This can be a heart attack.

danger_signs.sign: chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath, nausea, or pain spreading to the arm, jaw, or back
danger_signs.why: These together can be a heart attack.

danger_signs.sign: chest pain with fainting
danger_signs.why: This can be a serious heart or lung problem.

danger_signs.sign: chest pain with exertion that goes away with rest
danger_signs.why: This can be reduced blood flow to the heart.

possible_causes.description: Sore, sharp pain that is worse when pressing on the spot or moving, often after exercise or coughing.
Burning behind the breastbone after meals or lying down.

watch_for: pain becomes crushing or spreads to the arm, jaw, or back
you feel short of breath, sweaty, or faint

clusters.name: Arm, hand, wrist, or shoulder pain

ask_about.why: A fall, twist, or impact points to an injury
Swelling or an odd shape can mean a fracture
Not being able to use it suggests a more serious injury
Numbness or tingling can mean nerve involvement
Arm pain with chest symptoms must be ruled out

possible_cause_questions: Did it start after a sport, a fall, or lifting something?
Did you hear a pop or snap?

danger_signs.sign: arm pain with chest pain, shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea
danger_signs.why: Arm pain with these symptoms can be a heart attack.

danger_signs.sign: bone visible or limb clearly deformed
danger_signs.why: This needs emergency treatment.

danger_signs.sign: hand or fingers cold, pale, or numb after an injury
danger_signs.why: This can mean blood flow or nerve damage.

possible_causes.description: Stretched or torn ligaments or muscles, common after sports.
A broken bone often needs an X-ray to confirm.
Pain from repeated motion, building up over days.

watch_for: you can't move your fingers or wrist

clusters.name: Leg, knee, ankle, or foot pain

ask_about.why: A twist or impact points to an injury
Not being able to walk suggests a fracture
Swelling or deformity raises concern
A swollen, warm calf without injury can be a blood clot

possible_cause_questions: Did it start after running, a sport, or a fall?
Have you been on a long flight or drive recently?

danger_signs.sign: swollen, warm, painful calf with shortness of breath
danger_signs.why: This can be a blood clot that has moved to the lungs.

danger_signs.sign: bone visible or leg clearly deformed
danger_signs.why: This needs emergency treatment.

danger_signs.sign: one calf swollen, warm, and painful without injury
danger_signs.why: This can be a blood clot.

possible_causes.description: Twisting injury with swelling, common in sports.
Pain that builds over weeks, like shin splints.

watch_for: you can't put weight on it

clusters.name: Headache

ask_about.why: A sudden, worst-ever headache is a danger sign
Weakness, confusion, or vision changes are danger signs
Fever with stiff neck is a danger sign
A recent head injury changes urgency

possible_cause_questions: Did it build up slowly after screen time, stress, or poor sleep?
Have you had enough water and food today?
Do you get headaches like this often?

danger_signs.sign: sudden, worst headache of your life
danger_signs.why: A sudden severe headache can be bleeding in the brain.

danger_signs.sign: headache with weakness, confusion, trouble speaking, or vision loss
danger_signs.why: These can be signs of a stroke.

danger_signs.sign: headache with fever and stiff neck
danger_signs.why: This can be meningitis.

danger_signs.sign: headache after a head injury with vomiting or sleepiness
danger_signs.why: This can be a brain injury.

possible_causes.description: Pressure-like pain often linked to stress, screens, or poor sleep.
Throbbing pain, sometimes with nausea or light sensitivity.
Headache that improves with fluids and food.

clusters.name: Cough or breathing trouble

ask_about.why: Trouble breathing at rest is a danger sign
How long it has lasted
Fever suggests infection
Known asthma changes what to do

possible_cause_questions: Has anyone around you been sick?
Did it start after exercise, smoke, or allergies?

danger_signs.sign: can't breathe or speak in full sentences
danger_signs.why: This is a breathing emergency.

danger_signs.sign: lips or face turning blue or gray
danger_signs.why: This means low oxygen.

danger_signs.sign: short of breath while resting
danger_signs.why: Breathing trouble at rest needs urgent evaluation.

possible_causes.cause: a common cold or viral infection
possible_causes.description: Cough and congestion that improve over a week or two.
A lingering cough after a cold.
Wheezing or cough triggered by allergens or exercise.

watch_for: high fever that won't come down

clusters.name: Fever

ask_about.why: How high the fever is
Fever in a young infant is an emergency
Where the infection might be
Poor drinking or unusual sleepiness raises concern

possible_cause_questions: Has anyone around you been sick?
Any recent travel?

danger_signs.sign: fever in a baby under 3 months old
danger_signs.why: Young infants with fever need same-day emergency evaluation.

danger_signs.sign: fever with stiff neck and a rash that doesn't fade when pressed
danger_signs.why: This can be a serious infection.

danger_signs.sign: fever with confusion or very hard to wake
danger_signs.why: This can be a serious infection.

possible_causes.cause: a viral infection like a cold or flu
possible_causes.description: Fever with body aches, cough, or sore throat.

possible_causes.cause: an ear, throat, or urinary infection
possible_causes.description: Fever with pain in one area.

watch_for: trouble breathing, confusion, or a spreading rash

clusters.name: Sore throat or ear pain

ask_about.why: Fever with sore throat can mean strep
Trouble swallowing saliva or breathing is a danger sign
How long it has lasted

possible_cause_questions: Has anyone around you had strep throat or a cold?

danger_signs.sign: can't swallow saliva or trouble breathing
danger_signs.why: Severe throat swelling needs urgent care.

possible_causes.description: Often with a cold; improves in about a week.
Sore throat with fever and no cough; needs a test.
Ear pain, sometimes with fever.

watch_for: symptoms lasting more than a week

clusters.name: Rash, hives, or allergic reaction

ask_about.why: Breathing or swallowing trouble means a severe reaction
A new food, medicine, product, or sting
A spreading rash with fever raises concern

possible_cause_questions: Did you try a new food, medicine, soap, or detergent?
Were you stung or bitten?

danger_signs.sign: throat, tongue, or lip swelling, or trouble breathing
danger_signs.why: This can be a severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis).

danger_signs.sign: rash with fever that doesn't fade when pressed
danger_signs.why: This can be a serious infection.

possible_causes.description: An itchy rash from something that touched the skin, like a new detergent.
Raised itchy welts that come and go.

watch_for: any swelling of lips, tongue, or throat

clusters.name: Urinary symptoms

ask_about.why: Fever or back pain can mean a kidney infection
Blood in urine needs evaluation
Changes treatment and urgency

possible_cause_questions: Have you had a urinary infection before?

danger_signs.sign: fever with back or side pain and vomiting
danger_signs.why: This can be a kidney infection.

possible_causes.description: Burning and frequent urination.

clusters.name: Dizziness or fainting

ask_about.why: Actually passing out is more serious
Chest pain, palpitations, or weakness are danger signs
Dehydration or not eating are common causes

possible_cause_questions: Have you eaten and had enough to drink today?
Did it happen when you stood up quickly?

danger_signs.sign: fainting with chest pain, racing heart, or shortness of breath
danger_signs.why: This can be a heart problem.

danger_signs.sign: dizziness with weakness, confusion, or trouble speaking
danger_signs.why: These can be signs of a stroke.

danger_signs.sign: fainted and didn't wake up quickly
danger_signs.why: This needs emergency evaluation.

possible_causes.description: Lightheadedness that improves with fluids and food.
Brief dizziness when rising.
Spinning feeling that changes with head movement.

clusters.name: Mental health crisis

danger_signs.sign: thoughts of suicide or harming yourself
danger_signs.why: You deserve support right now. Call or text 988, or call 911 if you are in immediate danger.

clusters.note: Never ask diagnostic follow-ups here. Show 988 and 911 immediately.
